title: Preferred slot and duration
description: Tell us when you would like to hold the activity. Nothing is booked at this stage.

notice.title: State your preferences; IFDD will settle the final schedule.
notice.body: Do not worry about what other organizations have asked for: overlaps are expected at this stage and penalise no one. The team builds the programme once activities are selected, and will let you know the final time.

start.label: Preferred start
start.hint: During the event, {range}. The pavilion is open from {open} to {close}: your activity must end before closing time.

duration.label: Duration
duration.hint: Total time, including discussion with the audience. Between {min} and {max} minutes for this call.

sessions.label: Number of occurrences
sessions.hint: Leave 1 for a single activity. A recurring series declares several from the outset.

constraints.label: Scheduling constraints
constraints.hint: Days or times to avoid, dependency on another event, a speaker's availability.

errors.slotRequired: State the slot you would like.
errors.durationRequired: State the duration of your activity.
errors.durationRange: The duration must be between {min} and {max} minutes.
errors.outsideDailyWindow: The pavilion is open from {open} to {close}: your activity must start after opening and end before closing.
errors.sessionsRange: The number of occurrences must be between {min} and {max}.
errors.outsideEdition: The preferred slot must fall during the event.
